sections.title: Drag a template onto the canvas
sections.summary: Click and hold a template, then drop it on the canvas to add the screen. Double-click the new node to open the Screen Editor and configure it.

sections.title: Search for a screen type
sections.summary: Type to filter templates by name or description; the list updates as you type. Clear the field to see all templates.

sections.title: Open the Screen Templates panel
sections.summary: The right sidebar lists draggable screen templates with previews and is always visible. It is the primary way to add new screens to the canvas.

sections.title: Choose screen types intentionally
sections.summary: Question screens collect answers into variables for routing, content screens explain value, embed screens host custom HTML, and paywall screens sell products. Pick by what each step should accomplish.

sections.title: Screen names stay unique automatically
sections.summary: When you add a screen whose type already exists, the system appends a number (for example Hero Content 2). This keeps analytics and navigation unambiguous.
